name: Academic-first modular HOMER evidence policy

relevance_gate.rule: A source cannot be shortlisted without a requested parameter-family match. A study-domain match improves applicability but is not mandatory because technology costs and performance evidence can transfer across demand contexts.

rules: Use DOI or publisher metadata as the canonical identity for academic sources.
Do not treat ResearchGate or Academia.edu as the canonical source record.
Apply source quality and topical relevance as separate gates.
Treat geographic and application-context relevance as ranking factors only after topical relevance passes.
Preserve every provider, database name, query and retrieval date when duplicates are merged.
Prefer GCC-specific evidence; otherwise label transferability as climate_analogue or global.
Use official regulator or utility sources for tariffs even when academic sources exist.
Use measured farm data ahead of literature for chronological load profiles.
Do not accept AI-generated citations unless verified through Crossref, OpenAlex, a publisher, or an institutional repository.
Shortlisting is not human approval for model use.
